fusions.name: Poker from the Coals
fusions.desc: A weapon thrust with a red-hot iron deals 12 damage and sets the target [Burning] for 3 damage a second for 5 seconds. Your afflictions on the target spread to every enemy within 3.5 tiles.

fusions.name: Forest of Hot Iron
fusions.desc: Tines of white-hot iron erupt around you. The eruption deals 28 damage that ignores resistances to every enemy within 3 tiles and sets each [Burning] for 2 damage a second for 4 seconds.

fusions.name: Tempered in Embers
fusions.desc: Raises your armour by 20% for 10 seconds. You have 15% fire resistance.

fusions.name: While the Iron Glows
fusions.desc: Each time you afflict an enemy, your physical damage rises by 25% for 4 seconds. Once every 10 seconds.
